package_card.description: Luxury package card. Top half is image with a subtle zoom on hover. Bottom half uses crisp white background or glassmorphism. Typography: Playfair for title, Poppins for description. Price highlighted in Gold.
package_card.pattern: Relative wrapper -> Image (object-cover, h-64) -> Absolute top-right badge for duration -> Content block (p-6) -> Title -> Dest & Highlights -> Footer with Price and 'Book Now' button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure tailwind.config.js to include custom colors (primary: #071E3D, gold: #D4AF37, etc.) and fontFamily configurations for playfair, poppins, montserrat.
IMPORTANT: This is a JS project. When adding or using Shadcn components, ensure they use .js/.jsx extensions instead of .tsx.
Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'>. Use the Shadcn Calendar component for date pickers.
Forms: Full Name, Mobile, Email, Destination, Travel Date, Adults, Children, Package, Message. Must use Shadcn form components, style them softly with rounded borders to reflect the luxury vibe.
Admin Dashboard: Build with a clean, high-density layout using Shadcn UI elements. Use a crisp white/soft gray background with primary navy text for high contrast authority.

Navigation: A sticky header is required. Over the hero section, it should be glassmorphic/transparent (ensure a dark overlay exists on the hero image for legibility). On scroll, it must transition to solid white.
Implement scroll animations using framer-motion (e.g., 'whileInView' to fade in cards and sections).
Floating Action Buttons: Add a WhatsApp button on the bottom right and a Back to Top button on the bottom left (visible only after scroll).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, forms, links) with kebab-case naming.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific properties to avoid breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or softly rounded) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and elegant loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text, which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from `src/components/ui` when applicable.
